summary: The image, pipeline, .dockerignore and build verb land what P4's bullets name, and I re-ran `kc project build` green. One blocker: the image installs no librados2/librbd1, and the `pvginkel/homelab` provider every deploy repo declares is a cgo binary with DT_NEEDED librados.so.2/librbd.so.1, so Terraform cannot execute it — the phase's proof stopped at `terraform init`, which never launches a plugin.

findings.summary: Dockerfile:23-28 omits librados2/librbd1, so the cgo-linked pvginkel/homelab provider (DT_NEEDED librados.so.2, librbd.so.1) fails to exec at terraform apply in the hook image.
